# Desktop shell – conformance matrix (generated by the shell's tools/matrix.py)

Every clickable element of the boards this deliverable covers, from `docs/ui/CLICKS.md`, with the
status of its action in `design/conformance/coverage.toml` (ok / different / missing), the code that
implements it and the test that proves it. *Owner* names elements of other programs on the same board.
Side-by-side renders (board | implementation, and the implementation in ar/en × dark/light) are
listed in desktop-shell.md.
